title: Finding Yourself in a Map With Particles: A Cloud of Guesses, Weighed by What the Lidar Would See From Each, and the Room That Looks the Same From Two Places

artifact.note: Monte Carlo localisation against a map of walls and posts: a set of poses with weights, moved by the odometry with noise, weighed by how well the ranges a lidar would see from each match the ranges it saw (a hit and a random part), resampled when too few count, and summarised by a mean and a spread
